arguments.config:
# After the CircleCI docs "Using workflows to orchestrate jobs": fan-out and
# fan-in, an approval hold, branch and tag filters with regular expressions,
# and a requirement that also runs on failure.
version: 2.1
executors:
  base:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/base:2024.06
jobs:
  build:
    executor: base
    parallelism: 2
    steps: [checkout, {run: make build}]
  unit:
    executor: base
    parallelism: 4
    steps: [checkout, {run: make unit}]
  lint:
    executor: base
    steps: [checkout, {run: make lint}]
  publish:
    executor: base
    steps: [checkout, {run: make publish}]
  notify:
    executor: base
    steps:
      - run: echo build finished
workflows:
  build-test-deploy:
    jobs:
      - build:
          filters:
            tags:
              only: /^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/
      - unit:
          requires: [build]
          filters:
            tags:
              only: /^v.*/
      - lint:
          requires: [build]
          filters:
            branches:
              ignore: /dependabot\/.*/
      - hold:
          type: approval
          requires: [unit, lint]
          filters:
            branches:
              only: main
            tags:
              only: /^v.*/
      - publish:
          requires: [hold]
          context: [registry]
          filters:
            branches:
              only: [main, /release\/.+/]
            tags:
              only: /^v.*/
      - notify:
          requires:
            - build: [success, failed]

arguments.config:
# The CircleCI docs "Using matrix jobs" example: it calls node/install from
# the circleci/node orb, which kumitate never fetches.
version: 2.1
orbs:
  node: circleci/node@4.7
executors:
  docker:
    docker:
      - image: cimg/base:stable
  linux:
    machine:
      image: ubuntu-2404:current
  macos:
    macos:
      xcode: 27.1.0
jobs:
  test:
    parameters:
      os:
        type: executor
      node-version:
        type: string
    executor: << parameters.os >>
    steps:
      - checkout
      - node/install:
          node-version: << parameters.node-version >>
          install-yarn: true
workflows:
  all-tests:
    jobs:
      - test:
          matrix:
            parameters:
              os: [docker, linux, macos]
              node-version: ["14.17.6", "16.9.0"]
